name: rune-tablet
author: Lil Art
description: kRO's Rune Tablet in its official window: register runes in the Encyclopedia, build their sets on the Tablet and upgrade them to +15 at the official rates, and break items down into rune materials, for Episodes 17-21, Chapter 1 and the events. Talk to the Rune Tablet in Prontera (193, 189). Runs on the server's own Rune Tablet (1.6.6+), so registered runes and sets carry over. Renewal.
